title: Correlation Between CYP2C19 Genotype, Level Of Clopidogrel Metabolite And Platelet Inhibition Status
brief_summary: The aim of this study is to check correlation between CYP2C19 genotype level of clopidogrel metabolite in plasma and platelet inhibition status.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* \> 18 OLD PATIENTS
* THAT TAKE CLOPIDOGREL MORE THAN 1 WEEK

Exclusion Criteria:

* PREGNANCY
* CHRONIC LIVER DISEASES
study_population: THE RESEARCH WILL INVOLVE PATIENTS THAT TAKE CLOPIDOGREL AND READY TO GIVE INFORMED CONSENT FOR GENETIC TESTING.
